- Established the RFC process now used by 9 teams; mentored 6 engineers.

Shopfront - Software Engineer (2016 - 2020)
- Built the checkout service in Kotlin and Spring, handling peaks of 5,000 orders per minute on Black Friday.
- Introduced contract testing with Pact, lowering integration bugs found in staging by 45%.

DataPoint Labs - Junior Developer (2014 - 2016)
- Developed ETL jobs in Python for analytics dashboards.
